biotools.summary: A software pipeline for performing plasmid sequence verification using Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) and an in-house, easy-to-purify Tn5 transposase-based workflow (AistSeq). It processes sequencing data for *de novo* assembly, reference mapping, and annotation.
